source: The eight sentences written for voice_prompts_mixed.json, pulled out for review.
note:
TEMPORARY, FOR READING THROUGH ONLY -- do not record a set against this.
These are the eight sentences composed to cover the phonemes the five source texts could not supply: /ɔɪ/ was at 41, every instance of it in all of them, so no reselection could add one more. They lift /ɔɪ/ to 67, /ʒ/ to 53 and /θ/ to 64.
In the real set they are ids 0016, 0032, 0048, 0064, 0080, 0096, 0112 and 0128; the id shown HERE is just the position in this review list. A prompt id is a POSITION, not a sentence, which is why the real set was not reordered.

prompts.text: The boy heard a voice in the thorn thicket, and the noise of it brought him no joy at all.
She made her choice at the point where the three paths met, and rejoiced to be out of the wood.
The royal treasure lay in the moist soil, and nothing but patient toil would ever raise it.
Avoid the broken toy, said the voice, for the oil upon it is a poison to the touch.
They were loyal boys, and the joyful noise of their voices carried out through the thorns.
Point to the north, boy, and think of the truth of it: the soil is poor and the toil is long.
The old judge in the village measured out his usual pleasure with a strange gentleness.
She changed her mind at the edge of the bridge, and the vision of the gorge gave her no joy.

reading_notes: These are for checking the WORDS, not for recording. Read each one and say if any jars -- the register is meant to match the Grimm passages.
Each was written for a particular sound: 0001-0006 for the oi of boy and voice, 0007-0008 for the zh of measure and vision.
